_comment: These are hard numeric limits. Claude's reasoning/thesis step may NEVER override these values. Any proposed trade that violates a rule here must be rejected before it reaches review_equity_order, with no exceptions regardless of how strong the thesis sounds.
starting_capital_usd_note: Net deposits minus withdrawals, not live total_value -- excludes trading P&L so the loss-limit base doesn't drift with performance. Human updates by hand after each deposit/withdrawal.

position_sizing.min_top_up_note: A top-up only fires if the computed buy amount clears max($1.00 broker minimum, min_top_up_usd, min_top_up_pct_of_target x target_size for that candidate's conviction tier). Below that, skip without calling review_equity_order -- a top-up smaller than this doesn't move the position meaningfully, and letting headroom shrink toward zero every cycle otherwise generates a long tail of dust-sized orders as the position converges on target. Applies to top-ups only, never to new-entry sizing.

stop_loss.note: mode is 'fixed' or 'volatility_scaled' -- toggle only. 'fixed' uses the flat hard_stop_pct for every symbol. 'volatility_scaled': stop_pct per symbol = clamp(volatility_stdev_multiplier * stdev of daily close-to-close returns over volatility_lookback_trading_days, min_stop_pct, max_stop_pct), recomputed fresh from get_equity_historicals each cycle; falls back to fallback_stop_pct if historicals are unavailable or the symbol has fewer than 10 daily bars. Every open position must have this stop checked on every cycle, independent of any new thesis about the stock. A good new narrative does not cancel a stop-loss.

take_profit.note: Tiered partial take-profit, not a single full-exit threshold. Every open position must have this checked on every cycle, independent of any new thesis about the stock — this account is short-term oriented, not buy-and-hold. A good new narrative does not cancel a take-profit tier any more than it cancels a stop-loss. Each tier fires once (per holding period, i.e. since the position last closed to zero) when gain first reaches it, selling sell_fraction_of_position of the position's quantity at that moment — see PHASE_B_TASK.md Step 5 for the exact mechanics. After all three tiers have fired, the remaining quantity is held long indefinitely; only the stop-loss still applies to it.

wash_sale_avoidance.note: Toggle only -- set enabled to false to turn this guard off entirely; no other change needed. IRS wash-sale rule applies per taxpayer across ALL accounts, not per account, so this checks linked_accounts, not just account_number. Blocks BUYS only (new entries and top-ups) -- never blocks a stop_loss/take_profit/exit_existing sell, since risk management must never bend to a tax outcome; those sells are instead logged with a wash-sale flag if one applies, for the human's own tax tracking. This cannot prevent a wash sale caused by a purchase made LATER in another linked account after an agentic-account sell -- those accounts are outside this pipeline's control; only the human can avoid that side.

universe.supplementary_scan_note: Robinhood scan -- relative volume > 2.0x (30d) and market cap > min_market_cap_usd, matching signal_thresholds.volume_spike_multiple and this same block's own min_market_cap_usd rather than separate numbers. Additive to watchlist_max_candidates, not shared with it -- the watchlist's own slots are never crowded out by scan results. Create your own scan (relative volume + market cap filters) via the Robinhood MCP's create_scan tool and paste its scan_id here. Scan config has no upper market-cap bound; max_market_cap_usd still applies to its results via Phase A's post-merge filtering.

execution.note: mode must be manually changed from 'dry_run' to 'live' by the human. Claude must never change this value itself, and must refuse to place live orders while mode is 'dry_run'.

signal_thresholds._comment: A Step-1 candidate qualifies for a Phase A news search + thesis (i.e. counts as a 'notable signal') if it meets ANY ONE of these three, computed from data already pulled in Steps 1-2 (no extra API calls). This is a mechanical gate, not a judgment call. Currently-held positions are exempt and always get a thesis regardless of these thresholds.
